title: Tooling: 1.54× faster production data_corners.cpp via cached update columns with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/copied-fixed/data_corners.cpp` still paid a fresh update-column rebuild per pivot. The opt-in adapter `research/data-corner-performance/` already proved a per-pivot cached-column loop with identical 4,073,300-pair receipts. This PR wires that equivalent loop into the **production** source.

Only the `local_sha256` pin for `research/copied-fixed/data_corners.cpp` changes inside `research/copied-fixed/certificate.json`. The opt-in package vendors pairwise-era bytes as `baseline.cpp` and records the pre-production digest under `provenance_sha256`, so research-packages CI does not fail working-source drift. Historical inventories without VERIFY matrices are left as provenance.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched. Does not edit the e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST tree (#2263/#2276).

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median wall time **170.101 → 110.463 s (1.54×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Complete receipts match the baseline checker (4,073,300 pairs; 4,073,290 good / 10 fallback).

Package: `research/data-corner-production/`.
Tip: `2c7dfd60f7a45d7c6b433afb9d73346f13c59832`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/data-corner-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/data-corner-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/data-corner-production
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/data-corner-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_DATA_CORNER_PRODUCTION pairs=4073300 good=4073290 fallback=10 corruption=subprocess_failure certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/data-corner-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_DATA_CORNER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy column-fill foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still launch asserting C++ children (`NDEBUG` rejected). Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): `research/data-corner-performance/` (opt-in cached columns; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2257) / [#2263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2263) / [#2276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2276) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on production `data_corners.cpp` at refresh.

Credit the authors of `research/data-corner-performance/` and the copied-fixed lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
